RF1-18.name: Remaining Benefit Amount
RF1-18.note: hl7.eu hl7v281segmRF1.htm prints no row for RF1-18 (field 17 is followed by 19; the table ends at 25, Action Code). In v2.8 RF1-18 is Remaining Benefit Amount (MO). HAPI v281 instead renumbers RF1 to 24 fields, shifting 19-25 down by one; HL7 field numbers are not reused, so hl7.eu's numbering stands and RF1-18 is kept as a withdrawn position (no type) under its v2.8 name. Caristix 2.8.1 answers HTTP 500.

OBR-5.name: Priority
OBR-5.note: The official v2.8.1 chapter 4 (V281_CH04_Orders.pdf, HL7 Attribute Table – OBR – Observation Request, and 4.5.3.5 OBR-5: "retained for backward compatibilty only as of v 2.4") names this withdrawn field Priority, as v2.8 and hl7.eu std282 do (the PDF spells "compatibilty" so). hl7.eu hl7v281segmOBR.htm and HAPI v281 both print "Deliver-To Location" (HAPI numbers the repeats "Deliver-To Location Number 2" ...); hl7.org is authoritative, so the official name stands.
